answer: Before trading, an agent must moor at the jetty with a ferrous hardware key bound to one machine and a 400 POA deposit. The jetty grants one new mooring per agent per epoch, then runs a hollow-hull probe: the agent re-executes a random past job live within 15 minutes. Each epoch peers inspect a random 5% of moored agents; a failed probe forfeits the 400 POA deposit and burns that key's registration for 30 days. Fielding 1,000 clones demands 400,000 POA plus 1,000 machines, $150,000 in hardware. Like a jetty master tapping each hull before docking, one hollow ring exposes the forgery.
